title: Test every player control for skips
statement: Test every control in a film or scene player for an unintended way past unseen content, since the main flow can pass its tests while a side control skips it.
example: An eight-scene intro passed its flow tests, yet confirming its transcript skipped the remaining illustrated moments of a scene.
detail: A prototype intro with eight still-image scenes, three learning checks and saved progress passed its scene and check flow tests. A later recovery pass found that confirming the transcript let students skip the remaining illustrated moments in a scene. The next version fixed the skipped story moments and simplified the intro controls, and its eight-scene flow, three checks and saved progress passed interaction tests.
against: It rests on one bug in one prototype, caught by a later pass rather than by the tests. Whether students may skip at all is a separate design choice, barred elsewhere only for young learners.

evidence.quote: The scene/check flow passed tests; real-audio timing remains unverified.
I found a concrete intro bug: confirming the transcript lets students skip the remaining illustrated moments in a scene.
This version fixes skipped story moments, simplifies the intro controls, and includes the corrected narration script.
